Our keynote will feature a virtual fireside chat between me and Secretary Pete Buttigieg. The Rural Progress Summit is a virtual event that reaches rural Americans where they are. Rural communities play a vital role in shaping America's future, yet way too often they're left out of key policy conversations. This summit brings together voices from across the country to explore ideas and solutions that address the real needs of rural America. Today on the hot dish is a great friend, Mitch Landrew, former lieutenant governor of Louisiana, and former mayor of the great city of New Orleans, and any of you who have never been to New Orleans, that's your loss, the best food and the best fun in America.
